neighbours.label: the word for an urban municipality as a place: ' city', ' town' and translations such as ' ciudad'
fire: The mayor wants more trees planted across the city this spring.
A new tram line will connect the airport with the city center.
They moved to a small town in Ohio when she was six.
Residents of the town complained about the noise from the quarry.
The old market sits in the heart of the city and sells fish.
Las obras en la ciudad durarán todo el verano.
Everyone in Kansas City turned out for the parade on Saturday.
Cyclists say the city still lacks safe routes to the river.
quiet: The farmer wants more trees planted across the valley this spring.
A new tram line will connect the airport with the harbor terminal.
They moved to a small farm in Ohio when she was six.
Residents of the county complained about the noise from the quarry.
The old market sits in the heart of the island and sells fish.
Las obras en la carretera durarán todo el verano.
Everyone in Kansas turned out for the parade on Saturday.
Cyclists say the region still lacks safe routes to the river.

notes: The + pole fires on 'outside' and 'in front of'. Near misses use other place nouns (valley, county, island) in the same frames.
